verses.gurmukhi: ੧੨ : ਖੁਦੀ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਸਬਰ ਦੇ ਸੁਖ
verses.translit_en: 12 : khudhee dhe dhu'kh sabar dhe sukh

en.bdb: Sufferings of ego and delights of contentment
Millions of people full of wisdom adopt many a resolution.
Many enemies unwittingly go on increasing their enmity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੜਿ ਲੜਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਮੁਹੀਮ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: laR laR karan muheem aap ganaavahee|

en.bdb: They march for fightings and thus show their ego

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਜਦੀਦ ਕਦੀਮ ਨ ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: hoi jadheedh kadheem na khudhee miTaavahee|

en.bdb: From youth, though, they step in old age yet their egotism is not effaced.
Only the contented and the humble lose their sense of egocentricity.
